judgement.reason: Remark42 keeps all comment data in an embedded local BoltDB data file with no PostgreSQL or MySQL option, and Deployz provides no persistent disk.

evidence.quote: * No external databases, everything embedded in a single data file

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./var:/srv/var (docker-compose.yml remark)
reviews.reason: Remark42 keeps comments in an embedded local data file under /srv/var, and no shown setting moves that data to a managed database or S3, so the volume holds durable state.
